name: orosu-resume-intelligence
description: Strict, anti-hallucination resume tailoring, evidence matching, and JD intelligence skill for Orosu
author: Orosu Core Architecture
rules: The canonical Career Profile is the single source of truth.
Never fabricate companies, job titles, dates, technologies, metrics, skills, achievements, responsibilities, certifications, education, projects, or leadership experience.
Every generated factual statement must retain strict evidence provenance linking to a source block or profile item.
Rewrite statements only to improve clarity, grammar, and alignment with the target Job Description while preserving truth.
Intelligently omit empty sections and avoid placeholder values (e.g., 'Present' without date, 'Target Organization', 'Degree in Field of Study').
Return strict, schema-validated JSON outputs for all 4 discrete operations: analyze_job_description, match_candidate_evidence, tailor_resume, validate_tailored_resume.

analyze_job_description.description: Analyze raw Job Description into structured requirements, seniority, technologies, responsibilities, and evidence requirements.

match_candidate_evidence.description: Compare JD requirements against Canonical Career Profile and categorize matches into matched, partially_matched, or not_found with provenance.

tailor_resume.description: Generate an evidence-grounded tailored resume JSON prioritizing relevant experiences and skills for the target JD.

validate_tailored_resume.description: Rigorously validate that 100% of factual statements in the tailored resume are backed by source evidence in the profile.
